tool.label: Memory card
tool.description: Stores or reads the self-written anti-amnesia card: the exact text the extension will re-inject when your context is truncated. Omit text to read the current card.
tool.promptSnippet: memory_card: store/read the self-written anti-amnesia card
tool.guideline: If you receive the anti-amnesia bootstrap, save the card right away with memory_card. In autonomous cycles update activeWork at each phase change, and write "none" when the work is done.

param.text: Complete card (full replacement). Omit to read the card, or use activeWork to update only the checkpoint.
param.activeWork: Update ONLY the existing '## {active}' section, preserving all the others. Include objective, verified state, next step and blockers. Write "none" when the work is done.
param.role: Role label, informational only in the registry.
param.key: Key of the current Pi session (cannot point to other sessions).
param.systemPromptChannel: system prompt channel (every turn). Default OFF.
param.periodicChannel: Periodic channel (every N turns). Default ON.
param.randomReviewChannel: Random review channel (random cycle). Default ON.
param.block: Write ONE block only: 'always', 'active', 'objective', 'plan' or 'todo'. The other sections stay untouched. Requires 'value'.
param.value: The new body of the block named by 'block'. It replaces that section; if it does not exist yet, it is created at the end.
param.todoItem: Tick (or untick) ONE item of the 'todo' block: a 1-based index, or the item's text. An ambiguous address is refused.
param.todoDone: true (default) ticks the item, false unticks it.
param.todoStatus: Item state: 'pending', 'in_progress' or 'completed'. It takes precedence over todoDone. It is what lets a glance answer 'which task am I on'.

intro: You have just started: full context, known role. This is the only moment when
you can write a faithful memory card for yourself. Do it NOW with the `memory_card` tool,
bootstrap.draftLoaded: You have loaded the project DEFAULT DRAFT ({path}), which is not your own card: personalize it with the real role, session and project, then store it with `memory_card`.
bootstrap.detected: Data detected by Pi (use it as truth, do not invent):
keyNotice: The card will be saved with the key isolated to the current session.
Do not pass a different key; state the real role, not the full prompt text.
bootstrap.structure: Structure the card in Markdown sections. The user request may be just "continue":
bootstrap.sectionAlways: ## {always} — role, stable rules and absolute paths to re-read.
bootstrap.sectionActive: ## {active} — objective, verified state, next step, blockers, concrete files.
sectionActiveNote: Write "none" if the work is done. Update it at every phase change with
memory_card({ activeWork: "objective; verified state; next step; blockers" }).
bootstrap.sectionObjective: ## {objective} — the goal of THIS session, in one sentence. It does not change every turn.
bootstrap.sectionPlan: ## {plan} — the ordered steps, first to last. Mark progress as you go.
bootstrap.sectionTodo: ## {todo} — the operational checklist, one item per line as '- [ ] text'. Tick it with memory_card instead of rewriting the card.
bootstrap.sectionTopic: ## {topic}: word1, word2 — ARCHIVED/inactive notes, only for explicit requests.
bootstrap.topicWarning: Do not hide the active work under {topic}: it does not depend on the last prompt's words.
handoff: When the user changes task, update {active}; do not execute old plans
without comparing them with the new request and with the real state of the tools.
bootstrap.closing: Write it dense and operational: it will be re-injected verbatim when you are fogged.

inject.heartbeatFooter: [Session reminder: verify the real state before the next step.]
randomReview: [REVIEW THE CARD] Check objective, verified state, next step and blockers of {active}.
do not reactivate archived {topic} notes without an explicit request.
